title: Fixed Raised Pivot Bow and Empty Vise Horizontal Band Saw
description: One newly authored complete raised-pivot-bow horizontal-band-saw-inspired static inspection exterior. A long low whole stepped cabinet bed stands on four full rectangular feet and supports an empty transverse screw-vise arrangement. A separate right pivot standard and full transverse axle support one entire oblique dogbone-shaped rear bow with rounded ends and an open lower interval. Two complete stepped wheel exteriors, two full axles and one continuous finite-width blunt band form the head; the front cover is deliberately absent as an inspection-style display. A whole rear motor and full fixed descent-strut exterior belong to the bow. Two separate guide carriers, full small open-channel guides, long raised head handle and a complete open-spoke vise handwheel finish the single machine. Unlike the old compact vertical bench bandsaw, there is no tall C-frame with vertically stacked wheels or slotted cutting table. Unlike the old reciprocating bow saw, there is no straight toothed blade, sliding top ram, crank pin, connecting link or flywheel. Unlike the rail-bed sawmill, there is no long bunk bed, travelling portal or independently raised transverse head. The long low bed, transverse empty vise and single-end raised pivot bow are entirely newly authored together; no old wheel, band, bow, bed or vise geometry imported or rotated. One complete model zero scenes, four constant opaque untextured PBR roles, native metres Z up. Fixed empty art display only: no workpiece, sharpness, cutting, blade tracking or tension, blade twist mechanics, rotation, bow descent, clamping, motor internals, hydraulic circuit, fluid, feed, manufacturing, safe cover arrangement, operator protection or machinery safety capability. No rigging animation or interaction.
